facts.big: In my opinion… · Maybe we can…
facts.label: Opinião educada
facts.sub: Use In my opinion e I think para opinar. Diga algo bom e depois a crítica com but. Sugira com Maybe we can + verbo e agradeça no final.

facts.label: Opinião
facts.sub: Para dar uma opinião educada, comece com In my opinion… ou I think…. Depois diga a ideia: In my opinion, it’s nice. Evite frases secas como It’s bad.

facts.label: Ser gentil
facts.sub: Diga algo bom antes da crítica: It’s nice, but a little dark. A palavra but liga as duas ideias. Use a little ou too para não soar duro.

paragraphs: It is Friday afternoon in an office in Austin. Computers hum on every desk. Zoe looks at a big screen. Her coworker Ned stands behind her. The screen shows a new logo. Ned asks for her opinion.
“Zoe, can I ask for your opinion about the new logo?” says Ned. “Of course. In my opinion, it’s nice, but a little dark.” says Zoe. “I see. Which color is better, in your opinion?” says Ned.

She ___ every day. → shows
He is ___ now. → liking
